_readme: Fal pool - Hafez verses that ANSWER a held question. Persian copied byte-exact from the official Ganjoor data export (github.com/ganjoor/ganjoor-data), the same text ganjoor.net serves. Screened clear of wine imagery and of verses already published on @hamdam_au. Each carries its canonical Ganjoor URL as provenance - better provenance than verse-queue.json has.
_source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ganjoor/ganjoor-data@main/poets/hafez/ghazal/{slug}.json - 495 ghazals, 8,386 hemistichs, fetched 9 Sep 2026. The whole canon is reachable this way: 240 poets, 135,319 poems, plain HTTPS, no key. Supply was never the constraint.
_selection_rule: A fal verse must RESOLVE something: relief promised, patience rewarded, the lost returning, do not grieve. A verse about the beloved's beauty is not a fal answer, however beautiful. The test is whether it could answer a question a stranger is holding.
_ghazal_255_note: Ghazal 255 is the gham makhor ghazal - the single most drawn fal in Persian, and the one families turn to when someone is worried. Nine of its beyts qualify and four are pooled here. Space them across weeks rather than running them together, or the format reads as one poem rather than a divination.
_still_needed: Each verse needs englishSaid written before it can ship - Ganjoor is Persian only. That is now the real constraint, not supply. Ealia reviews every Persian and English line.

verses.persian:
ای دل غمدیده، حالت بِه شود، دل بَد مکن
وین سرِ شوریده باز آید به سامان غم مخور
verses.gloss: Grieving heart, your state will improve - do not despair. This restless head will find its order again. Do not grieve.
verses.published: 2026-09-11 08:30 Brisbane, instagram.com/reel/DdH6brkk_en/ - reach 1214, 14 saves, 4 shares, 35 likes, 7.5s avg watch. Best post on the account by a wide margin.

verses.persian:
دورِ گردون گر دو روزی بر مرادِ ما نرفت
دائماً یکسان نباشد حالِ دوران غم مخور
verses.gloss: If the turning of the world went against us for a day or two - the times are never permanently one way. Do not grieve.

verses.persian:
هان مَشو نومید چون واقِف نِه‌ای از سِرِّ غیب
باشد اندر پرده بازی‌هایِ پنهان غم مخور
verses.gloss: Do not lose hope - you are not privy to what is hidden. There may be games being played behind the curtain. Do not grieve.

verses.persian:
گرچه منزل بس خطرناک است و مقصد بس بعید
هیچ راهی نیست کآن را نیست پایان، غم مخور
verses.gloss: Though the stage is dangerous and the destination far - there is no road that has no end. Do not grieve.

verses.persian:
نفسِ بادِ صبا مُشک‌فشان خواهد شد
عالَمِ پیر دگرباره جوان خواهد شد
verses.gloss: The breath of the morning wind will scatter musk. The old world will be young again.

verses.persian:
مژده ای دل که دگر بادِ صبا بازآمد
هدهد خوش‌خبر از طَرْفِ سبا بازآمد
verses.gloss: Good news, heart - the morning wind has come back. The hoopoe has returned from Sheba bringing word.

verses.persian:
بر سرِ آنم که گر ز دست برآید
دست به‌کاری زنم که غصّه سرآید
verses.gloss: I have it in mind that if it lies within my power, I will set my hand to something that ends the sorrow.

verses.persian:
گفتم غمِ تو دارم گفتا غمَت سرآید
گفتم که ماهِ من شو گفتا اگر برآید
verses.gloss: I said: I carry sorrow for you. It said: your sorrow will end. I said: be my moon. It said: if it comes to pass.

verses.persian:
زهی خجسته زمانی که یار بازآید
به کامِ غمزدگان غمگُسار بازآید
verses.gloss: What a blessed hour, when the friend comes back - when the one who eases sorrow returns to those who carry it.

verses.persian:
دارم امّید بر این اشکِ چو باران که دگر
برقِ دولت که بِرَفت از نظرم بازآید
verses.gloss: I have hope, on these tears like rain, that the lightning of fortune which passed out of my sight will come back.

verses.persian:
گفتم ای بخت بخفتیدی و خورشید دمید
گفت با این همه از سابقه نومید مشو
verses.gloss: I said: fortune, you slept, and the sun has risen. It said: for all that, do not despair of what went before.

verses.persian:
تعبیر رفت «یار سفرکرده می‌رسد»
ای کاج هر چه زودتر از در درآمدی
verses.gloss: The reading came out: 'the one who travelled is arriving.' If only they would come through the door sooner.
